objective: 🐸 Fren Review FIX <ID> — close a proven vulnerability in the Magic Internet Frens Cauldron: <TITLE>. Its PoC is in test/fren-review/<ID>/. acceptanceCriteria: The change is confined to the listed source files and test/fren-review/<ID>/, and changes nothing unrelated to the root cause.
The PoC in test/fren-review/<ID>/ now asserts the safe outcome and would fail if the vulnerability returned; variants the fix must cover are tested too.
forge build and forge test pass, and `forge build --sizes` shows every contract's runtime code under 24,576 bytes.
